user.title: Glass Panes
user.description: Add Glass Panes to Home Assistant. Add displays afterwards with the glass_panes.save_display action.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Glass Panes is already set up.

set_bindings.name: Set bindings
set_bindings.description: Replace which entities feed which widgets. Pass pane id, then widget id, then slot name, then the entity (or list of entities). Administrators only.

bindings.name: Bindings
bindings.description: Everything at once: pane id -> widget id -> slot -> entity id(s).

show_pane.name: Show pane
show_pane.description: Make a display show a pane. Does the same as choosing it on the display's select entity.

display.name: Display
display.description: The display's id, as shown in its player address.

pane.name: Pane
pane.description: The id of the pane to show.

save_display.name: Save display
save_display.description: Create a display, or change one that has the given id. Administrators only.

id.name: Id
id.description: Leave empty to make one from the name. Give an existing id to change that display.

timezone.name: Timezone
timezone.description: For the times it shows, such as America/Chicago. Empty uses the viewing device's own.

pane.name: Pane
pane.description: The pane it shows to start with.

endpoint.name: Mirror address
endpoint.description: Where the display's Mirror Kiosk app listens, such as mirror.local:8099 (host and port only). Empty removes it. The mirror key cannot be set here; use the builder.

delete_display.name: Delete display
delete_display.description: Remove a display and its select entity. Administrators only.

set_pane_bindings.name: Set pane bindings
set_pane_bindings.description: Replace the entities bound to ONE pane and leave every other pane's bindings alone. An empty object clears that pane. Administrators only.

bindings.name: Bindings
bindings.description: widget id -> slot -> entity id or list of entity ids.

list_media.name: List media
list_media.description: Return the uploaded pictures and videos (id, name, kind, size).

get_schema.name: Get schema
get_schema.description: Return the pane rules (JSON Schema), the widget catalogue, the canvas size, grid and safe zone. Call this before writing a pane.

list_panes.name: List panes
list_panes.description: Return every pane: id, name, description, where it came from and how many widgets it has.

get_pane.name: Get pane
get_pane.description: Return one pane, where it came from, and the entities bound to it.

create_pane.name: Create pane
create_pane.description: Make a new pane, blank or as a copy of another. Administrators only.

copy_from.name: Copy from
copy_from.description: The id of a pane to copy.

save_pane.name: Save pane
save_pane.description: Save a whole pane. It is checked exactly as the builder checks it; an invalid pane is refused and nothing is saved. Administrators only.

delete_pane.name: Delete pane
delete_pane.description: Delete a pane you saved (a built-in one you changed goes back to the original). Refused while a display is showing it. Administrators only.

get_mirror_status.name: Get mirror status
get_mirror_status.description: Read the live status of a display's mirror: page loaded, presence, real measured memory and a plain verdict. Administrators only. Never returns the key.

set_mirror_presence.name: Set mirror presence
set_mirror_presence.description: Turn camera presence on or off on a display's mirror. Administrators only.

tune_mirror_presence.name: Tune mirror presence
tune_mirror_presence.description: Change presence settings on a display's mirror; give any of them. Same ranges as the mirror app. Administrators only.

fps.name: Camera frame rate
fps.description: 0 to 30; 0 is the slowest the camera offers.

set_mirror_brightness.name: Set mirror brightness
set_mirror_brightness.description: Set the backlight of a display's mirror, 0 to 100 percent. Administrators only.

measure_presence_cost.name: Measure what presence costs
measure_presence_cost.description: Reads memory, turns presence off for about 20 seconds, reads again, and always turns presence back on. Returns the measured difference. Administrators only.

confirm.name: Confirm
confirm.description: Must be true: presence is off for about half a minute.

start_draft.name: Start a draft
start_draft.description: Start building a pane in a draft. Nothing is shown on a display and nothing appears in the pane list until finish_draft. Start blank (give a name), from a copy of a pane (copy_from), or with a working copy of a pane you want to change (edit). Returns the draft's id. Administrators only.

name.name: Name
name.description: The new pane's name (needed unless you give edit).

description.name: Description
description.description: A short description of the pane.

copy_from.name: Copy from
copy_from.description: Start from a copy of this pane (its id).

edit.name: Edit
edit.description: Start a working copy of this pane to change it. finish_draft with replace saves over it.

list_drafts.name: List drafts
list_drafts.description: List your drafts: id, name and the widgets in each. Administrators only.

get_draft.name: Get a draft
get_draft.description: Return a whole draft: its pane (every widget) and the entities bound to it. Administrators only.

draft.name: Draft
draft.description: The draft's id, as start_draft or list_drafts gave it.

add_widget.name: Add a widget
add_widget.description: Add a widget to a draft. Call get_schema first to learn the widget types and their options. A widget goes at x and y if given, else directly under another widget (below), else the first free spot. Entities are never part of the pane: give them in `entities` (slot name -> entity id, or a list for a slot that takes several) or bind them later with bind_widget. Returns the widget with its id. Administrators only.

draft.name: Draft
draft.description: The draft's id, as start_draft or list_drafts gave it.

type.name: Type
type.description: The widget type, for example clock, weather or calendar_agenda.

name.name: Name
name.description: A label for the widget in the builder. Also used to make its id.

x.name: X
x.description: Distance from the left edge, in pixels (0 to 1080).

y.name: Y
y.description: Distance from the top edge, in pixels (0 to 1920).

h.name: H
h.description: Height in pixels. Setting it makes the height fixed.

below.name: Below
below.description: Put the widget directly under this widget (its id) instead of giving y.

gap.name: Gap
gap.description: Space in pixels between the two when using below (default 20).

options.name: Options
options.description: The widget's options (see get_schema), merged over its defaults.

style.name: Style
style.description: Style: font, size, weight, color, opacity, align, italic, uppercase, letter_spacing, line_height.

auto_height.name: Auto height
auto_height.description: Let the height follow the content.

entities.name: Entities
entities.description: Entities for this widget: {slot: entity id or list}.

update_widget.name: Change a widget
update_widget.description: Change a widget's name, options, style or show-when rule. Options and style are merged over what is there; set a key to null to remove it. Where it is and how big it is are changed with place_widget. Administrators only.

draft.name: Draft
draft.description: The draft's id, as start_draft or list_drafts gave it.

widget.name: Widget
widget.description: The id of a widget in the draft.

options.name: Options
options.description: Options to change (merged). A key set to null is removed.

style.name: Style
style.description: Style to change (merged). A key set to null is removed.

auto_height.name: Auto height
auto_height.description: Let the height follow the content, or not.

when_hidden.name: When hidden
when_hidden.description: What an off or empty widget does to the layout: collapse (default) or keep.

show_when.name: Show when
show_when.description: A rule that switches the widget on and off: {match: all|any, conditions: [...]}. See get_schema for the condition kinds.

place_widget.name: Move or resize a widget
place_widget.description: Move and/or resize a widget. Give x and y, or below to sit directly under another widget. Everything stays inside the 1080 x 1920 canvas. The widget is pinned to these numbers (it stops flowing after another widget). Administrators only.

draft.name: Draft
draft.description: The draft's id, as start_draft or list_drafts gave it.

widget.name: Widget
widget.description: The id of a widget in the draft.

x.name: X
x.description: Distance from the left edge, in pixels (0 to 1080).

y.name: Y
y.description: Distance from the top edge, in pixels (0 to 1920).

h.name: H
h.description: Height in pixels. Setting it makes the height fixed.

below.name: Below
below.description: Put the widget directly under this widget (its id) instead of giving y.

gap.name: Gap
gap.description: Space in pixels between the two when using below (default 20).

snap.name: Snap
snap.description: Round x, y, w and h to the 40 px grid.

remove_widget.name: Remove a widget
remove_widget.description: Remove a widget. Whatever flowed after it closes up, and its entities are forgotten. Administrators only.

draft.name: Draft
draft.description: The draft's id, as start_draft or list_drafts gave it.

widget.name: Widget
widget.description: The id of a widget in the draft.

bind_widget.name: Bind an entity to a widget
bind_widget.description: Bind an entity (or a list) to one of a widget's slots, or clear the slot. Slot names come from get_schema (for example weather has `weather`, calendar_agenda has `calendars`). A slot starting with when_ belongs to a show-when condition. Administrators only.

draft.name: Draft
draft.description: The draft's id, as start_draft or list_drafts gave it.

widget.name: Widget
widget.description: The id of a widget in the draft.

entity.name: Entity
entity.description: An entity id like weather.home, or a list of them for a slot that takes several. A status summary's checks and a news widget's feeds also accept rules.

clear.name: Clear
clear.description: Clear this slot instead of binding.

align_widgets.name: Align widgets
align_widgets.description: Line up two or more widgets: left, center, right, top, middle, bottom, same-width, same-height, or (three or more) distribute-h and distribute-v. Administrators only.

draft.name: Draft
draft.description: The draft's id, as start_draft or list_drafts gave it.

widgets.name: Widgets
widgets.description: The ids of the widgets to align.

set_pane.name: Change the pane itself
set_pane.description: Change the draft's name, description, theme, background colour, brightness or fade. Themes: moss, cream, creamnight, midnight, paper, slate, or original to remove it. Administrators only.

draft.name: Draft
draft.description: The draft's id, as start_draft or list_drafts gave it.

theme.name: Theme
theme.description: A colour theme, or original to remove it.

background.name: Background
background.description: A background colour like #000000 (black is see-through on a two-way mirror). A theme replaces it.

brightness.name: Brightness
brightness.description: Backlight percent to ask for while this pane shows (0 to 100).

fade.name: Fade
fade.description: Fade widgets in and out when their show-when rule switches them (new panes start with this on).

burn_in_saver.name: Burn in saver
burn_in_saver.description: Drift the whole pane a few pixels very slowly, against burn-in on screens left on for hours.

finish_draft.name: Finish a draft
finish_draft.description: Save the draft as a real pane. The person can then open it in the Glass Panes builder and edit it by hand, or show it on a display. It becomes a new pane by default. A draft started with `edit` can instead replace that pane, but only when you ask with replace. Administrators only.

draft.name: Draft
draft.description: The draft's id, as start_draft or list_drafts gave it.

replace.name: Replace
replace.description: Overwrite the pane this draft was started from (only for a draft started with edit).

discard_draft.name: Discard a draft
discard_draft.description: Throw a draft away. Nothing else is changed. Administrators only.

draft.name: Draft
draft.description: The draft's id, as start_draft or list_drafts gave it.
